generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Name, Address of contractor, Phone number, E-Mail address and registration copy etc should be submitted on line.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The proposed methodology and program of construction backed with equipment, materials and manpower planning and deployment, duly supported with broad calculations including Environmental Management Plan and Quality Assurance Plan with quality control procedures proposed to be adopted, justifying their capability of execution and completion of the work as per technical specifications within the stipulated period of completion as per milestones.
The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
Conditional tenders will be rejected.
The tender processing fee will neither be refunded nor will be transferred to other works.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders.

Contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorised quality control authority, before execution.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The work includes all lead and lift and work shall be carried out as per the instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge of the work.

If CNNL wishes to engage third party inspecting agency for the said work, apart from the Quality Control authorities and field tests of the Nigama and Contractor, then the contractor should co-operate with the third party test and Quality Control authorities.
Any necessary documents can be uploaded in spaces provided for general documents in upload document section.
The successful bidder whose tender is approved, should fulfill all the conditions stipulated in tender document and enter into agreement with Nigama in stipulated time.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The Bidder shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP on or before the last date of bid submission.

EMD and Tender processing fee shall be paid through e-Payment using the following four modes of Payment: a. Credit card payment, b. Direct debit payment, c. National electronic fund transfer, d. Over the Counter (OTC)
The bidder should be abided to all the terms and conditions laid down in approved tender bid document.

technicalCriterionList.description: A minimum number of one similar contracts -Rehabilitation and Improvement works to Dams-that have been satisfactorily and substantially completed as a prime contractor, joint venture member, between 1st April, 2019 and bid submission deadline:(1) ONE contract, each of minimum value 594.39 Lakhs (80% of the Estimated Value) OR (2)TWO contracts, each of minimum value 445.79 Lakhs (60% of the Estimated Value) OR (3) THREE contracts, each of minimum value 297.19 lakhs (40% of the Estimated Value).

For the above and any other contracts (substantially completed and under implementation) as prime contractor, joint venture member or Sub-contractor between 2019-20 and application submission deadline a minimum construction experience in the following key activities successfully completed (1) Providing & applying poly ironite Ceramic cementatious (PICC): 1008.00 Sqm (2) Providing and laying In-situ cement concrete: 1179.47 Cum (3) Providing 75mm thick shotcreting: 995.40 Sqm (4) Cleaning Concrete / Masonry: 4304.58 Sqm (5) Grouting the body of the dam through concrete/masonry: 78.00 Tonne.

Experience under construction contracts such as -Rehabilitation and Improvement works to Dams- in the role of prime contractor, JV member, subcontractor, for at least the last seven years, starting 1st April 2019.

Bidders who meet the minimum qualification criteria will be qualified only if their available bid capacity for construction work is equal to or more than the total bid value of the work. The available bid capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed Available bid capacity (AxNx1.15-B) Where, A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last seven years (updated to the price level of the financial year 2026-27 at the rate of 5% per year), taking into account the completed as well as works in progress). N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which bids are invited (period upto 6 months to be taken as half-year and more than 6 months as one year). B-Value, at the current price level, of existing commitments on on-going works to be completed during the period of completion of the works for which bids are invited.

Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded. The Bidder must demonstrate that it will have access to the key Contractors equipment listed as per qualification criteria section-4 Equipment in the bid document. (1) Pneumatic Grout Pump-2Nos (1-Own & 1-Lease/Rent) (2) Screw Compressor-2Nos (1-Own & 1-Lease/Rent) (3) Diesel Generator min 30 KVA-1No (1-Own) (4) Concrete mixer (Own-1, Rent/Lease-1) (5) Tipper (Own-1, Rent/Lease-1) (6) Asphalt Paver machine-1 (O/R/L) (7) Drilling and reaming equipment (Own-1, Rent/Lease-1) (8) Shotcrete equipment (Own-1, Rent/Lease-1) Note:Availability (either owned or leased) of equipments such as suitable capacity and number of Excavator, tippers, Concrete mixer, Air Compressor, Vibratory roller/Jack hammer, Needle vibrator, Electrically operated rotary drilling machine, etc as required along with the equipments already mentioned in the bid document.

The Bidder shall demonstrate that it has access to, or has available, liquid assets, unencumbered real assets, lines of credit, and other financial means (independent of any contractual advance payment) sufficient to meet the construction cash flow requirements estimated as Rs.185.74 Lakhs about 3 months cash flow at peak construction period) for the subject contract(s) net of the Bidders other commitments.

The Bidder shall provide details of the Key Personnel and such other Key Personnel that the Bidder considers appropriate, together with their academic qualifications and work experience. The Bidder shall complete the relevant Forms in Section-4, Bidding Forms. The key personnel requirement is as per qualification criteria of Section-3 Key personnel. (1) Construction Manager-1 No BE (Civil)-10 Years Experience (2) Grouting Specialist-1 No BE (Civil)-10 Years Experience (3) Site Engineer-1 No BE (Civil)-5 Years Experience (4) Site Engineer-1 No BE (Electrical)-5 Years Experience (5) Quality Control Engineer-1 No BE (Civil)- 3 Years Experience. (6) Surveyor -Diploma (Civil)- 3 Years Experience (7) Safety, Environment & Social Expert (Need Based)- BE Civil/ Graduate in Environment/ Health- 1 Year Experience.

Minimum average annual construction turnover of Rs.1485.98 Lakhs calculated as total certified payments received for contracts in progress and/or completed within the last seven financial years, divided by seven years.
